title: Simple harmonic motion
description: Recognise and solve the SHM equation $\ddot{x} = -n^2 x$; derive the velocity formula $v^2 = n^2(A^2 - x^2)$ using $a = v\frac{dv}{dx}$; write displacement in the form $x = A\sin(nt + \alpha)$ or $x = A\cos(nt + \alpha)$; find amplitude, period, maximum speed and maximum acceleration; solve SHM problems in context.
